title: Exotic Dense Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of Saudi Arabia with these dense and briny lamb kebabs, featuring lime leaves and a unique blend of spices, cooked to perfection on a salt block.
instructions: Preheat the salt block to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, temper, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on the preheated salt block and cook for 10-12 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
During the last 2 minutes of cooking, place a lime leaf on top of each skewer.
Remove the skewers from the salt block and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional lime leaves if desired.
